title: eludite.browser.find input
description: Find elements on a tab's page and get refs for them, deterministically: by CSS selector (`css`), by visible text (`text`, DevTools' search: a plain string matches text and attribute values), or by accessibility role and name (`role`, with an optional `name` matched case-insensitively as a substring). Give exactly one of `css`, `text` and `role`. Answers up to `max` matches (default 20) in document order with ref, role, name and box. Cheaper than reading the whole page when you know what you look for. No model is involved: a selector that matches nothing answers no matches. Fails with "no tab" when the browser has no tab: call eludite.browser.tab_open first.

text.description: Text to search for (DOM.performSearch); a text match answers its element.

name.description: With `role`: the accessible name contains this (case-insensitive).

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
